# opencode-limits-go [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/cusvv/opencode-limits-go?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/cusvv/opencode-limits-go/releases/latest) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/cusvv/opencode-limits-go/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square&label=CI)](https://github.com/cusvv/opencode-limits-go/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/opencode-limits-go?style=flat-square)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-limits-go) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![OpenCode](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenCode-v2.3%2B-111827?style=flat-square)](https://opencode.ai) [![Language](https://img.shields.io/badge/Lang-EN%20%7C%20RU-16a34a?style=flat-square)](#localization) **OpenCode Go** quota monitor plugin for **OpenCode v2.3+** (TUI & Desktop GUI). Live usage across all three OpenCode Go windows — **5-hour rolling**, **weekly**, and **monthly** — with smart pace estimation, a 5h trend sparkline, threshold & reset alerts, deep strip/dialog customization, English/Russian localization, and GitHub auto-updates. --- ## Screenshots

More screenshots: Compact Settings Dialog & Terminal TUI

--- ## Highlights ### Quota & Pace Intelligence - **All OpenCode Go windows**: `5h` / `1w` / `1m` percentages, reset timestamps, countdowns, elapsed-time markers (`|`), recent deltas (`+X%`), and tightest-window summary. - **Smart pace estimation & 5h sparkline**: Combines window-average and snapshot history to detect coding bursts (`⚡`) and renders a `5h trend` SVG sparkline inside the dialog. - **OpenCode Zen & today's models**: Shows active Console budgets (`$spent / $limit`), today's Go tokens / Zen USD spend, and the **top 3 models** used today. - **Reset-aligned & instant cold start**: Persists the last valid snapshot to disk for 0 ms startup, schedules a targeted refresh 3 seconds after any window resets, respects `Retry-After` on `429`/`503`, and slows background polling 3× when minimized. ### Deep Customization (Desktop GUI & TUI) - **Window modes**: Show any combination of `5h` / `1w` / `1m` (click window labels right inside `/limits` to toggle), or enable **Auto-focus (`tightest`)** to display only the most constrained window. - **Auto-hide below threshold**: Keep the strip hidden while all windows are below `50%` / `70%` / `80%`. - **Visual themes & density**: - **4 bar palettes**: `Traffic` (green/amber/red), `Monochrome`, `Calm blue`, and `Stealth` (neutral until `100%`). - **3 strip densities**: `Compact`, `Normal`, `Wide`. - **Indicator styles**: `Bar + %`, `Text only`, `Bars only`, optional **Remaining %** mode (`% left` instead of `% used`), toggleable `⚡` icon and `|` elapsed marker. - **Reset countdown on strip**: `Never`, `At 100% only` (default), `At warning & 100%`, or `Always`. - **Dialog & time formatting**: `24h` / `12h` clocks, `Date + countdown` / `Countdown only` / `Date only`, and individual toggles for pace banner, sparkline, Zen stats, and auth footer. - **Smart alerts**: Threshold toasts (`70%` / `80%` / `90%` / `100%`), **quota-reset recovery toasts** when a `100%` window clears, and **fast-burn spike alerts** (`+15%` / `+20%` / `+30%` in 5–30 min). - **GUI ↔ TUI sync**: Window filters, `% left` mode, thresholds, burn-spike sensitivity, and language override sync across Desktop GUI and TUI via plugin RPC (and can also be seeded via `options` in `opencode.json`). ### Works with any OpenCode auth setup - OpenCode Console **OAuth** account (`opencode`) - Saved **API key** (`opencode-go` or `opencode` integration) - Environment variables (`OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`, `OPENCODE_API_KEY`, `OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY`) - Plugin options or provider settings in `opencode.json` - Lazy fallback to `opencode auth export` and legacy `~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json` ### Localization Automatically follows your OpenCode UI language (**English** / **Russian**), or can be overridden manually (`Auto` / `EN` / `RU`) in **Settings → Behavior & language**. ### Security & Auto-Updates - Tokens never leave the server process — never sent over RPC, never shown in the UI, and automatically redacted from logs (`%TEMP%/opencode-limits-go.log` or `/tmp/opencode-limits-go.log`). - Local/manual installs auto-update from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/cusvv/opencode-limits-go/releases); CLI-managed installs (`opencode plugin add`) defer cleanly to `opencode plugin update`. --- ## Installation Requires **OpenCode v2.3.0+** and an active OpenCode Go credential (`opencode auth login` or `OPENCODE_API_KEY`). ### Option 1: Quick Install via OpenCode CLI (recommended) ```sh opencode plugin add opencode-limits-go # or directly from GitHub: opencode plugin add github:cusvv/opencode-limits-go ``` Restart **OpenCode Desktop** (or run `/reload` in open TUI sessions). ### Option 2: Clone with Git ```sh # macOS / Linux git clone https://github.com/cusvv/opencode-limits-go.git ~/.config/opencode/local-plugins/opencode-limits-go ``` ```powershell # Windows (PowerShell) git clone https://github.com/cusvv/opencode-limits-go.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.config\opencode\local-plugins\opencode-limits-go" ``` ### Option 3: Download Release Archive Download `opencode-limits-go.zip` or `opencode-limits-go.tar.gz` from [Releases](https://github.com/cusvv/opencode-limits-go/releases) and extract it to: - **Windows**: `%USERPROFILE%\.config\opencode\local-plugins\opencode-limits-go` - **macOS / Linux**: `~/.config/opencode/local-plugins/opencode-limits-go` ### Enable in `opencode.json` (Options 2 & 3) Add `./local-plugins/opencode-limits-go` to `plugins` in `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`: ```jsonc { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "plugins": [ "./local-plugins/opencode-limits-go" ] } ``` > **Optional dotfiles defaults:** You can also pass a token or shared defaults via `options`: > ```jsonc > { > "plugins": [ > { > "package": "./local-plugins/opencode-limits-go", > "options": { > "token": "{env:OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY}", > "showRemaining": false, > "warnThreshold": 80, > "burnSpikePct": 20, > "langOverride": "auto" > } > } > ] > } > ``` Restart **OpenCode Desktop** (and run `/reload` in open TUI sessions). No `npm install` is required — `dist/gui-experimental.cjs` is prebuilt. --- ## Usage & Shortcuts | Action | Shortcut / Command | |---|---| | Show limits dialog / popup | `/limits` or `Ctrl+Shift+L` (or click the status strip) | | Open quick settings (Desktop & TUI) | `/limits-settings`, gear button in dialog, or `Settings → OpenCode Go limits` | | Filter TUI sidebar windows | `/limits-windows` (`All`, `5h·1w`, `5h·1m`, `1w·1m`, or single window) | ### Verify via CLI ```sh opencode plugin list opencode api post /api/rpc/opencode-limits-go/status --data '{"input":{"force":true}}' ``` --- ## Development ```sh npm install npm test # Run unit tests across src/core and src/server npm run build # Typecheck server/TUI/GUI and rebuild dist/gui-experimental.cjs ``` ### Project Architecture ```text src/ index.ts Server plugin: RPC endpoints, disk/memory cache, reset-aligned timers rpc.ts Portable RPC contract (status, getPrefs/setPrefs, updates, events) gui.tsx Desktop GUI entrypoint (SolidJS + OpenCode GUI SDK) tui.tsx TUI entrypoint core/ Pure domain logic (zero Node/UI dependencies) index.ts Barrel exports types.ts Types, error codes, window selection & auto-hide helpers format.ts Dates (24h/12h), durations, usage parsing, short error labels pace.ts Snapshot ring buffer, deltas, pace estimation, SVG sparkline data alerts.ts Threshold, reset recovery, and fast-burn spike detectors stats.ts Provider spend & top-model aggregation summary.ts TUI sidebar & detail formatter utils.ts Secret redaction, retry, semver server/ Node / IO layer api.ts OpenCode Go HTTP client with Retry-After support auth.ts Multi-source credential discovery & deduplication updater.ts GitHub Releases updater with HTTPS allowlist & recursive sync log.ts Rotating async JSON logger with secret redaction gui/ Desktop GUI modules i18n.ts EN/RU translations stores.ts Effect Schema stores & constants components.tsx MiniBar, Sparkline, LimitsStrip, SectionDivider tui/ Terminal UI modules i18n.ts EN/RU TUI copy plugin.tsx OpenTUI adapter dist/ gui-experimental.cjs Prebuilt CommonJS Desktop GUI bundle ``` --- ##
